For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Santosh Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Binod Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL KUMAR PANWAR
ORAL ORDER 2 22-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 376, 323, 324, 504 of the Indian Penal Code.
As per FIR, the allegation against the petitioner is that he committed rape to the complainant/informant on the pretext of solemnization of marriage.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
The complainant/informant demanded money from the petitioner and on denial to fulfill the same he has falsely been implicated in this case.
There is no prior complaint of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24738 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 any wrongdoing lodged against the petitioner.
As per impugned order, it appears that the complainant/informant is a major lady and she has consensual relationship with the petitioner.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 30.01.2023.
Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Hajipur P.S. Case No. 29 of 2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Vaishali at Hajipur.
